seriesTitle: It's Okay to Not Be Okay

episodes.title: The Boy Who Fed On Nightmares
episodes.summary: Moon Gang Tae has a striking run-in with his brother's favourite author, Go Moon Young, when she comes to his hospital to read to the children.

episodes.title: The Lady in Red Shoes
episodes.summary: Moon Young invites Moon Sang Tae to a book signing event that ends with a nasty commotion. Gang Tae hears about a job opening in his hometown.

episodes.title: Sleeping Witch
episodes.summary: Having followed Gang Tae, Moon Young begins teaching literature classes at his new hospital. Chaos breaks out when a VIP patient runs away.

episodes.title: Zombie Kid
episodes.summary: The VIP patient's incident triggers childhood memories for Kang Tae, who remains an emotional puzzle to Moon Young. Lee Sang In arrives in town.

episodes.title: Rapunzel and the Cursed Castle
episodes.summary: With nowhere else to take Moon Young, Kang Tae brings her back to his place. Discovering her there surprises everyone, most of all Nam Joo Ri.

episodes.title: Bluebeard's Secret
episodes.summary: When Moon Young offers an opportunity to Sang Tae, Kang Tae is forced to bend to their will. A patient at the hospital rattles Moon Young.

episodes.title: The Cheerful Dog
episodes.summary: Kang Tae takes a day off from work to spend time with Moon Young, who seems to need a distraction. While drinking alone, Joo Ri encounters Sang In.

episodes.title: Beauty and the Beast
episodes.summary: Seeing Moon Young with something that belongs to him upsets Sang Tae. When a belligerent visitor shows up at the hospital, Kang Tae snaps.

episodes.title: King Donkey Ears
episodes.summary: Kang Tae and Moon Young decide to go on a day trip together. During their mountain getaway, an unforeseen situation crops up.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Cried Wolf
episodes.summary: Refusing to go home, Sang Tae coops himself up in a room. Kang tae wrestles with the demons of his past and the constraints of his present.

episodes.title: The Ugly Duckling
episodes.summary: An escaped patient shows up at the mansion. Moon Young makes an effort to change Sang Tae's mind about allowing her a place in the brother's lives.

episodes.title: Romeo and Juliet
episodes.summary: Wanting to overcome his trauma, Sang Tae opens up about his darkest memory. A cruel twist of fate threatens Kang Tae's newfound happiness.

episodes.title: The Father of the Two Sisters
episodes.summary: Sang Tae shows Kang Tae that he's been practicing drawing his greatest fear. Moon Young receives word about her father's worsening condition.

episodes.title: The Hand, The Monkfish
episodes.summary: The identity of the vandal who ruined Sang Tae's mural sends everyone into a state of shock. Moon Young struggles to process a devastating truth.

episodes.title: A Tale of Two Brothers
episodes.summary: After a chilling phone call, Kang Tae rushes over to the mansion. Later, Moon Young asks the brothers to leave her -- but they refuse to listen.

episodes.title: Finding the Real Face
episodes.summary: Moon Young decides she's going to publish the new fairy tale after all. Everyone comes together at the hospital for a reading of the book.
